actual_character_lattice_obligation.abstract_core_conclusion: For q^2-1 core equations in an arbitrary torsion-free lattice, all involved nonzero characters lie in one cyclic subgroup; unused direct summands are not excluded at this stage.
actual_character_lattice_obligation.forbidden_shortcut: A rank-one ansatz or accidental equality of character values cannot replace actual ambient-character surjectivity.
actual_character_lattice_obligation.full_window_conclusion: At m=kq-1, TB4 kills every other original residue. Ambient coordinate restrictions then generate the actual X*(H), the surviving pattern contains w, and every character is 0 or d^beta w; hence X*(H)=Z w, w is primitive, and dim H=1.

arbitrary_rank_colored_component_obligat.cycle_rule: Exclusive A/B/C labels connect exactly two nonzero coordinates with d-exponent edge weight 1 or 0. A nonzero signed cycle weight would force v=d^s v, so each component has integer heights.
arbitrary_rank_colored_component_obligat.encoding: Give every connected component a distinct formal color e_C and set F_i=T^(h_i)e_C; then F_(j+q)=F_j+T F_(j+L) in the direct sum of colored Laurent modules.
arbitrary_rank_colored_component_obligat.extinction: A minimum-height B-persistence chain and the triangular zero set force both u_(r+qL)=0 and u_(r+Lq)!=0 after q^2 core equations.
arbitrary_rank_colored_component_obligat.uniqueness: With q^2-1 equations every nonzero component must contain N_*=(L+1)q-1, so disjointness leaves exactly one component.

explicit_laurent_shadow_obligation.first_collision: The next coefficient is 1+T^q, proving character extinction at q^2 without finite enumeration.
explicit_laurent_shadow_obligation.semigroup_guard: The complete involved backward and forward degrees remain below Lq and (q-L)q, so each coefficient is zero or one monomial.

original_window_obligation.at_kq: Every one of g residues has q^2 core equations; all involved characters u_0 through u_(kq+k-1) vanish.
original_window_obligation.at_kq_minus_1: Residues 0 through g-2 have q^2 equations and residue g-1 has q^2-1; only the last residue can carry the unique shadow.
original_window_obligation.forbidden_endpoint: u_(2kq-1) is not the general endpoint.

part_a_obligation.coefficientwise_sharpness: E_(k-1) is nonempty for every coefficient tuple; after a compatible finite extension and for a compatible finitely generated group, T_(k-1) is infinite, while BG17 plus EXT-L gives finite T_k for every finite-rank group.
part_a_obligation.equality_rigidity: The saturated predecessor relation lattice has rank 2m; equality dim H=k-m forces H=H_m.
part_a_obligation.normalized_scheme: E_m uses the exact active interval, root equations, both open nonvanishing families, and coordinate-by-coordinate inverse reconstruction.
part_a_obligation.universal_family: Fixed actual support and unit coefficients give an open in Z(P_univ)^alpha_m times a free torus, flat relative lci, smooth over the discriminant complement; local equations are completed fiber equations.

q2_general_g_obligation.active_core: For q=2 the CBA shadow lifts iff a=-1 and b c^(d-1)=-1, with scalar tuple (b s^d,s,c,-s,b(-s)^d) and primitive exponent vector.
q2_general_g_obligation.generic_fill: For every inactive residue when g>1, Phi(x,y)=(y,c+b y^d-x) is a polynomial automorphism; avoid finitely many proper coordinate-zero hypersurfaces over the infinite field to obtain the required nonzero full-window scalar segments.

seven_label_obligation.index_and_zero_guards: All selected indices lie in [0,q^2-2]; F_(z_*)=0 is proved separately for 2L<q and 2L>q, while 2L=q is excluded for q>=3.
seven_label_obligation.scalar_conclusion: Shared coordinates force b c^(d-1)=-1 and a=-1; the Z equation with old, middle, and future scalars all c yields 2c=0, impossible in characteristic zero.

part_a.statement: Every translate xi H contained in V_m with dim H=k-m has underlying subgroup H=H_m.
Geometric points of the explicit locally closed normalized scheme E_m classify all normalized maximum-dimensional translates.
E_m is nonempty coefficientwise; squarefree and reduced component counts and multiple-root nilpotent directions have the exact stated geometric-fiber qualifiers.
The fixed-support universal E_m is an open root-scheme product, flat relative lci and smooth over the discriminant complement, with the stated completed fiber local ring.

part_b.statement: Every support-one local character identity has exactly one exclusive A, B, C, or Z label and the fixed scalar sign table.
Original indices split into g independent gcd residue cores.
Arbitrary-rank d-scaling components have integer heights and satisfy the colored Laurent recurrence.
q^2 consecutive core equations extinguish every involved character.
q^2-1 core equations admit exactly one nonzero colored Laurent shadow up to its character generator.
At m=kq-1 only residue g-1 may carry TB5; at m=kq every residue is extinguished.
For q>=3 the unique shadow has the seven forced labels at the stated indices.
For q>=3 the seven labels have no scalar lift, so V_(kq-1) contains no positive-dimensional torus translate.
For q=2 a positive-dimensional translate exists at m=kq-1 iff a=-1 and b c^(d-1)=-1, including the general-g inactive-residue fill.
